addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

# 清泉跨境系统（企业级）

多平台（Amazon / TikTok / Temu）运营数据汇总与任务闭环的企业私有化平台。

数据以 **PostgreSQL 为 Source of Truth**，飞书多维表为同步出口；采集端复用现有海外仓 / Temu / TK 三套工具，经统一 Ingest API 上报。

## 文档

| 文档 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| [docs/中台产品蓝图.md](docs/中台产品蓝图.md) | **中台.xmind 产品蓝图**：老板驾驶舱、部门域、分期对齐 |
| [docs/AMZ环比异常-人维任务草案.md](docs/AMZ环比异常-人维任务草案.md) | AMZ 样板：环比异常→人维任务→负责人（表/接口草案） |
| [docs/架构方案.md](docs/架构方案.md) | 总体架构、分期、部署 |
| [docs/会议纪要-技术会.md](docs/会议纪要-技术会.md) | 技术会需求摘要 |
| [docs/字段映射字典.md](docs/字段映射字典.md) | 采集 ↔ 中心表 ↔ 飞书字段 |
| [docs/Phase0-实施计划.md](docs/Phase0-实施计划.md) | 2–3 周基座计划 |
| [docs/TK中心化改造方案.md](docs/TK中心化改造方案.md) | TK 广告先上报中心再写飞书 |
| [docs/openapi-v1.yaml](docs/openapi-v1.yaml) | Phase0 OpenAPI |

## 目录

```
backend/          FastAPI 中心服务
deploy/           docker-compose
collectors/       边缘采集与 Agent SDK
docs/             方案与字典
packages/         共享库（预留）
web/              管理端（Phase0 后补）
```

## 快速启动（Phase0 骨架）

本机当前已验证路径：**无 Docker**，使用本机 PostgreSQL 16 + Python venv。

### 前置

- Python 3.12+
- PostgreSQL 16（服务监听 `127.0.0.1:5432`）
- Node.js（任务台前端）
- （可选）Docker Desktop：有的话可用 `deploy/docker-compose.yml`

### 本机启动 API

```powershell
cd "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）"
copy .env.example .env   # 首次

# 确认库用户/库已建：qingquan / qingquan @ qingquan
# 并已执行 backend\migrations\001_init.sql

$env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql+asyncpg://qingquan:qingquan@127.0.0.1:5432/qingquan"
$env:APP_SECRET_KEY = "dev-secret-change-me"
$env:INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY = "dev-ingest-key"
$env:ADMIN_USERNAME = "admin"
$env:ADMIN_PASSWORD = "admin123"
$env:PYTHONPATH = "$PWD\backend"

cd backend
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.scripts.seed
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

也可用辅助脚本：`scripts\dev-local.ps1`（自动建库/迁移，视本机 PG 安装路径而定）。

默认管理员：`admin` / `admin123`（登录后请修改）。

### 验证

```powershell
# health
Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8000/health

# 模拟 TK 广告上报（两次，第二次应 duplicated）
$env:QINGQUAN_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8000"
$env:QINGQUAN_API_KEY="dev-ingest-key"
.\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe .\collectors\agent-core\mock_ingest_tiktok.py
```

API 文档：http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

### 任务台（Vue）

```powershell
cd web
npm install
npm run dev
```

打开 http://127.0.0.1:5173 ，账号 `admin` / `admin123`。  
Vite 已代理 `/api`、`/health` → `8000`。

### Docker 方式（可选）

```powershell
cd deploy
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.seed
```

### Worker（飞书同步）

在 `.env` 填入飞书应用与任务表后，另开终端：

```powershell
cd backend
$env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql+asyncpg://qingquan:qingquan@127.0.0.1:5432/qingquan"
# ... 其它 FEISHU_* 环境变量
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.jobs.worker
```

飞书多维表需包含列（可调 `task_to_fields` 映射）：平台、业务ID、异常类型、标题、状态、进度、去重键。

## 与现有项目关系

| 项目 | 路径 | 策略 |
|------|------|------|
| 海外仓 | `E:\project\海外仓` | 发货桥暂独立；赛狐客户端后续抽到 sellfox-worker |
| Temu | `E:\project\temu` | Phase1 增加中心上报 |
| TK 广告 | `E:\project\海外TK店铺广告投流数据自动化监测` | 按 [TK中心化改造方案](docs/TK中心化改造方案.md) 旁路 dual 写入 |

**清泉跨境任务台**是 Vue 前端，本地默认这样访问：

## 访问地址

打开浏览器访问：

**http://127.0.0.1:5173**

默认账号：
- 用户名：`admin`
- 密码：`admin123`

---

## 启动步骤（如果还没开）

任务台依赖后端 API，需要**两个服务都在跑**。

### 1. 启动后端 API（端口 8000）

```powershell
cd "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）"
$env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql+asyncpg://qingquan:qingquan@127.0.0.1:5432/qingquan"
$env:APP_SECRET_KEY = "dev-secret-change-me"
$env:INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY = "dev-ingest-key"
$env:ADMIN_USERNAME = "admin"
$env:ADMIN_PASSWORD = "admin123"
$env:PYTHONPATH = "$PWD\backend"

cd backend
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

或用辅助脚本：`scripts\dev-local.ps1`

### 2. 启动任务台前端（端口 5173）

另开一个终端：

```powershell
cd "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）\web"
npm install   # 首次需要
npm run dev
```

然后打开 http://127.0.0.1:5173 登录即可。

---

## 说明

- Vite 已把 `/api`、`/health` 代理到 `8000`，前端不用单独配后端地址
- API 文档（可选）：http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

如果打开 5173 打不开或登录失败，多半是 API 没起来，或 PostgreSQL 没在跑。需要的话我可以帮你在本机检查这两个服务是否在线。

-- 010 TikTok 异常任务（对齐飞书 AMZ「异常任务」表形态）
-- 飞书参考：ASIN健康度监控 · 异常任务
--   主键 / 日期 / 店铺 / ASIN / 产品 / 中文名称 / 异常类型 / …
-- TK 映射：ASIN → product_id（或 seller_sku）；其余协作字段对齐 public.task
-- 依赖：001_init.sql · 008_tk_schema.sql（schema tk 已存在）
--
-- 正式链路：规则/人工/Ingest → tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task（+ 可选投影 public.task）
--          → 同步 Job → 飞书「TK异常任务」

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS tk;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 异常任务事实（飞书「异常任务」镜像；SoT 在 PG）
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    -- 飞书「主键」：稳定业务键，如 T20260804-a1b2c3d4 或 tiktok:{shop}:{product}:{type}:{date}
    task_key            TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_date            DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT (CURRENT_DATE),
    shop_id             UUID REFERENCES public.shop(id),
    shop_external_id    TEXT,
    shop_name           TEXT,
    -- 对象：商品优先；活动/店铺级异常时 product_id 可空，object_ref 必填
    product_id          TEXT,
    seller_sku          TEXT,
    product_name        TEXT,
    product_name_cn     TEXT,
    object_ref          TEXT,
    object_type         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'product'
                        CHECK (object_type IN ('product', 'campaign', 'shop', 'order', 'other')),
    -- 异常类型（中文稳定名，与飞书单选一致；code 进 anomaly_code）
    anomaly_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
    anomaly_code        TEXT,
    priority            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'P1'
                        CHECK (priority IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2')),
    -- 协作
    status              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
                        CHECK (status IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'cancelled', 'ignored')),
    owner_name          TEXT,
    owner_user_id       UUID REFERENCES public.org_user(id),
    due_at              TIMESTAMPTZ,
    progress_note       TEXT,
    summary             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    metric_snapshot     TEXT,
    -- 关联中心任务引擎（可选）
    center_task_id      UUID REFERENCES public.task(id),
    anomaly_event_id    UUID REFERENCES public.anomaly_event(id),
    dedupe_key          TEXT,
    raw_extra           JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    source_url          TEXT,
    row_status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'success',
    ingest_id           UUID REFERENCES public.ingest_raw(id),
    collected_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    resolved_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (task_key)
);

-- 未闭环：同店+对象+异常类型 唯一（与 public.task 开放单规则对齐）
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_tk_anomaly_task_open_dedupe
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (dedupe_key)
    WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND dedupe_key IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tk_anomaly_task_date
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (biz_date DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tk_anomaly_task_status
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (status, priority, biz_date DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tk_anomaly_task_shop
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (shop_external_id, biz_date DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tk_anomaly_task_product
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (product_id)
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tk_anomaly_task_owner
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (owner_name)
    WHERE owner_name IS NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tk_anomaly_task_type
    ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (anomaly_type, status);

COMMENT ON TABLE tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task IS
    'TK 异常任务；对齐飞书 AMZ「异常任务」：主键/日期/店铺/商品/中文名/异常类型/负责人/状态；经 PG 再同步飞书';
COMMENT ON COLUMN tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task.task_key IS '飞书主键；幂等键';
COMMENT ON COLUMN tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task.product_id IS 'TK 商品 ID（对应 AMZ ASIN）';
COMMENT ON COLUMN tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task.product_name_cn IS '中文名称';
COMMENT ON COLUMN tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task.anomaly_type IS '飞书展示用中文异常类型';
COMMENT ON COLUMN tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task.anomaly_code IS '机器码，如 stock_low / roi_low / sales_drop';
COMMENT ON COLUMN tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task.dedupe_key IS '未闭环去重：tiktok:{object}:{anomaly_code}';

-- public 兼容视图（报表/旧 SQL）
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.fact_tk_anomaly_task CASCADE;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.fact_tk_anomaly_task AS
    SELECT * FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task;
COMMENT ON VIEW public.fact_tk_anomaly_task IS '兼容视图 → tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task';

-- 授权
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task TO qingquan;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 异常类型字典（可选配置；规则引擎可读）
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type (
    code            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name_cn         TEXT NOT NULL,
    object_type     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'product',
    severity_default TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'warn'
                    CHECK (severity_default IN ('info', 'warn', 'high', 'critical')),
    priority_default TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'P1'
                    CHECK (priority_default IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2')),
    description     TEXT,
    enabled         BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    sort_order      INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- 种子已 TK 针对化；完整清单与说明见 011_tk_anomaly_types_specialize.sql
-- 此处保留最小可启动集，011 会 upsert 全量并停用旧 AMZ 口径码
INSERT INTO tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type (code, name_cn, object_type, severity_default, priority_default, description, sort_order)
VALUES
    ('ads_roi_low',          '广告ROI过低',     'campaign', 'high',     'P1', '活动 ROI 低于目标或阈值', 10),
    ('ads_spend_no_sale',    '广告空耗',       'campaign', 'high',     'P1', '花费>0 无成交', 20),
    ('product_stockout',     '商品断货',       'product',  'critical', 'P0', '可售库存=0 或断货', 60),
    ('product_stock_low',    '商品库存不足',   'product',  'high',     'P0', '库存低于补货阈值', 70),
    ('product_sales_drop',   '商品销量骤降',   'product',  'high',     'P1', '销量环比下降超阈', 90),
    ('shop_gmv_drop',        '店铺GMV骤降',    'shop',     'high',     'P1', '店日 GMV 环比下降', 130),
    ('shop_health_low',      '店铺健康分低',   'shop',     'critical', 'P0', '健康分低于红线', 160),
    ('shop_late_dispatch',   '延迟发货率高',   'shop',     'high',     'P0', '延迟发货率超阈', 170),
    ('other',                '其它',           'other',    'info',     'P2', '未分类', 999)
ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET
    name_cn = EXCLUDED.name_cn,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled;

GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type TO qingquan;

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.dim_tk_anomaly_type CASCADE;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.dim_tk_anomaly_type AS
    SELECT * FROM tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type;

COMMENT ON TABLE tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type IS 'TK 异常类型字典；name_cn = 飞书「异常类型」选项';

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.api import auth, export_feishu, health, ingest, kb, shops, tasks
from app.config import get_settings


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()
    app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_name, version="0.1.0")
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=["*"],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )
    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(auth.router)
    app.include_router(shops.router)
    app.include_router(ingest.router)
    app.include_router(tasks.router)
    app.include_router(kb.router)
    app.include_router(export_feishu.router_export)
    app.include_router(export_feishu.router_collectors)
    return app


app = create_app()

16	-- 把 public 下已有 TK 相关表挪到 tk（若仍在 public）
17	DO $$
18	DECLARE
19	  t text;
20	  tables text[] := ARRAY[
21	    'fact_ads_campaign_daily',
22	    'fact_tiktok_order',
23	    'fact_tiktok_product',
24	    'fact_tiktok_shop_daily',
25	    'fact_tiktok_health_daily',
26	    'fact_tiktok_finance_daily'
27	  ];
28	BEGIN
29	  FOREACH t IN ARRAY tables LOOP
30	    IF EXISTS (
31	      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables
32	      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = t
33	    ) AND NOT EXISTS (
34	      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables
35	      WHERE table_schema = 'tk' AND table_name = t
36	    ) THEN
37	      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I SET SCHEMA tk', t);
38	      RAISE NOTICE 'moved public.% to tk.%', t, t;
39	    ELSIF EXISTS (
40	      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables
41	      WHERE table_schema = 'tk' AND table_name = t
42	    ) THEN
43	      RAISE NOTICE 'already in tk.% — skip', t;
44	    ELSE
45	      RAISE NOTICE 'table % not found in public or tk — skip (create via earlier migrations first)', t;
46	    END IF;
47	  END LOOP;
48	END $$;
49	
50	-- public 兼容视图：旧 SQL / 报表若仍写 public.fact_* 可继续用
51	-- （写入仍应打 tk. 或依赖 search_path）

59	    'fact_tiktok_shop_daily',

63	BEGIN

66	      SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables
67	      WHERE table_schema = 'tk' AND table_name = t AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
68	    ) THEN
69	      EXECUTE format('DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.%I CASCADE', t);
70	      -- 若 public 上还残留同名空壳则上面已处理；用视图转发
71	      BEGIN
72	        EXECUTE format('CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.%I AS SELECT * FROM tk.%I', t, t);
73	        EXECUTE format('COMMENT ON VIEW public.%I IS %L', t,
74	          '兼容视图 → tk.' || t || '；新代码请直接用 tk.' || t);
75	      EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_table THEN
76	        -- public 仍是 BASE TABLE（迁移未挪走）时忽略
77	        RAISE NOTICE 'public.% still base table, no view', t;
78	      END;
79	    END IF;
80	  END LOOP;
81	END $$;

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain import task_engine
from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/tasks", tags=["tasks"])


class TaskCreate(BaseModel):
    platform: str
    shop_id: str | None = None
    anomaly_type: str
    biz_id: str
    title: str
    owner_user_id: str | None = None
    due_at: datetime | None = None
    progress_note: str | None = None


class ProgressBody(BaseModel):
    note: str = Field(min_length=1)
    status: str | None = None
    action_code: str | None = None


class ResolveBody(BaseModel):
    note: str | None = None
    action_code: str | None = None
    effect_code: str | None = None


@router.get("")
async def list_tasks(
    status: str | None = None,
    platform: str | None = None,
    shop_id: str | None = None,
    owner_user_id: str | None = None,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    clauses = ["1=1"]
    params: dict[str, Any] = {
        "limit": page_size,
        "offset": (page - 1) * page_size,
    }
    if status:
        clauses.append("status = :status")
        params["status"] = status
    if platform:
        clauses.append("platform = :platform")
        params["platform"] = platform
    if shop_id:
        clauses.append("shop_id = :shop_id")
        params["shop_id"] = shop_id
    if owner_user_id:
        clauses.append("owner_user_id = :owner_user_id")
        params["owner_user_id"] = owner_user_id

    where = " AND ".join(clauses)
    total = (
        await db.execute(text(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE {where}"), params)
    ).scalar_one()
    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT id::text, dedupe_key, status, platform, shop_id::text, anomaly_type,
                       biz_id, title, owner_user_id::text, due_at, progress_note,
                       created_at, updated_at, resolved_at
                FROM task
                WHERE {where}
                ORDER BY updated_at DESC
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
                """
            ),
            params,
        )
    ).mappings().all()
    return {"total": total, "items": [dict(r) for r in rows]}


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_task(
    body: TaskCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        task = await task_engine.upsert_task_from_anomaly(
            db,
            platform=body.platform,
            shop_id=body.shop_id,
            anomaly_type=body.anomaly_type,
            biz_id=body.biz_id,
            title=body.title,
            detail=body.progress_note,
            owner_user_id=body.owner_user_id or user["id"],
        )
        return task
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{task_id}/progress")
async def progress(
    task_id: str,
    body: ProgressBody,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return await task_engine.update_progress(
            db,
            task_id,
            body.note,
            status=body.status,
            operator_user_id=user["id"],
            action_code=body.action_code,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{task_id}/resolve")
async def resolve(
    task_id: str,
    body: ResolveBody,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return await task_engine.resolve_task(
            db,

14	| 维度 | 归档 Spec（目标） | 现有实现 / 文档 | 差距 |
15	|------|-------------------|-----------------|------|
16	| 一句话 | 监督员工是否处理异常 + 过程留痕 | 多平台经营中台蓝图（采购/财务/多域导航 + 任务中心） | 蓝图更宽；**差异化主线（人与过程）未产品化** |

# 差距盘点：归档 Work OS Spec vs 现有实现

| 字段 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| 日期 | 2026-07-28 |
| 对照制品 | `docs/specs/SPEC-qingquan-work-os.md`、`MVP-qingquan-work-os.md`、`ACCEPTANCE-qingquan-work-os.md` |
| 代码基线 | `backend/` + `web/` + `collectors/`（Phase 0 中心基座 + AMZ 环比样板） |
| 结论摘要 | **基座有、Work OS 主线未落地**。现有 `task` 模型是「异常任务跟踪」雏形，距 Spec 的 Case/认领/处置字段/监督台/飞书群通知仍有结构性差距。 |

---

## 1. 产品方向对照

| 维度 | 归档 Spec（目标） | 现有实现 / 文档 | 差距 |
|------|-------------------|-----------------|------|
| 一句话 | 监督员工是否处理异常 + 过程留痕 | 多平台经营中台蓝图（采购/财务/多域导航 + 任务中心） | 蓝图更宽；**差异化主线（人与过程）未产品化** |
| 主体界面 | 员工工作台 + 老板监督台 | Vue 导航含「异常任务中心」「老板驾驶舱」等，多为壳/域规划 | 无独立「认领→处置→关闭」与「超时红灯监督」闭环 UI |
| 飞书定位 | **群机器人通知**（必做）；非主库 | **Bitable 同步**任务表（`sync_feishu_*` / Worker） | 方向相反：有多维表同步，**无群 Webhook @人** |
| 智能推荐 C | 1.0 不做，只攒字段 | 无推荐引擎 | 对齐（都不做）；但 **C 预留字段也没有** |

---

## 2. MVP 六件事逐项对照

| # | MVP Ship-now | Spec 要求 | 现有能力 | 状态 |
|---|--------------|-----------|----------|------|
| 1 | 案件本子 + 状态机 | `open → claimed → closed`；关案必填 disposition + rationale | `task`: `open / in_progress / resolved / cancelled`；`progress_note` 可选关案 | **部分** — 无认领态、无强制处置字段 |
| 2 | 信号建案 | `temu_alert` / `tiktok_risk` / `fulfillment_exception` | `ingest` + `upsert_task_from_anomaly`；AMZ 环比规则种子；模拟采集脚本 | **部分** — 通用建任务有；三类型 Case 契约未固定 |
| 3 | 员工工作台 | 认领 → 填处置 → 关闭；未认领不可关 | 任务列表/进度 API；Web 任务中心偏列表 | **缺口** — 无 claim API/UI 规则 |
| 4 | 老板监督台 | 按人/店/超时筛选 + 红灯 | 任务可按 owner/status/platform 筛；`due_at` 有 | **缺口** — 无 SLA 分类型、无超时红灯监督视图 |
| 5 | 案件时间线 | append-only：create/claim/close/… + actor/ts | `task_progress` 有 note/from/to/operator | **部分** — 有流水雏形，缺结构化 activity 与处置结果 |
| 6 | 飞书群通知 | 新建/超时 → 群 @ + 深链；失败不挡闭环 | 飞书 **多维表** create/update；无群消息/Webhook | **缺口** |

---

## 3. 数据模型对照

| Spec 概念 | 期望字段/行为 | 现有表/字段 | 差距 |
|-----------|---------------|-------------|------|
| Case | case_type、状态机 claimed、SLA 双时限 | `task` + `anomaly_type`、`due_at` 单截止 | 需扩展或映射 Case 语义 |
| CaseEvent | activity 枚举、actor、outcome | `task_progress` | 需结构化 activity / outcome |
| 自创字段 | disposition_code、rationale、outcome_label、false_positive | 无 | **全缺** |
| 角色 | manager / operator / admin | `org_user.is_admin` 布尔 | 无三角色权限模型 |
| 通知日志 | 群发送成功/失败 | 无（仅 bitable map/job） | **全缺** |
| 幂等 | case_type + source_ref | `dedupe_key = platform:biz_id:anomaly_type` + open 唯一索引 | 思路可复用，类型命名需对齐 |

---

## 4. 可复用资产（实现 Work OS 时优先用）

| 资产 | 路径 | 用途 |
|------|------|------|
| 登录 JWT | `backend/app/api/auth.py` | 1.0 简单账号（A8） |
| 店铺主数据 | `shop` + `api/shops.py` | 按店筛选 / 负责人 |

## 5. 不应在 1.0 继续做深的（相对 Work OS Spec）

| 项 | 原因 |
|----|------|
| 采购/财务/美工完整产品线 | Spec Out of Scope；导航可保留壳，不占 MVP |

"""采集上报：幂等写入 ingest_raw，并按 source 分发到事实表。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import require_ingest_key

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/ingest", tags=["ingest"])


class Evidence(BaseModel):
    screenshot_url: str | None = None
    source_url: str | None = None
    raw_ref: str | None = None


class IngestEnvelope(BaseModel):
    platform: str | None = None
    shop_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="外部店铺 ID")
    shop_name: str | None = None
    biz_date: date | None = None
    collected_at: datetime | None = None
    idempotency_key: str
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    evidence: Evidence | None = None


class IngestBatch(BaseModel):
    items: list[IngestEnvelope] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


async def _resolve_shop_uuid(db: AsyncSession, platform: str | None, external_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not external_id:
        return None
    if platform:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text FROM shop
                    WHERE external_shop_id = :eid AND platform = :platform
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"eid": external_id, "platform": platform},
            )
        ).first()
        if row:
            return row[0]
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text("SELECT id::text FROM shop WHERE external_shop_id = :eid LIMIT 1"),
            {"eid": external_id},
        )
    ).first()
    return row[0] if row else None


async def _process_tiktok_ads(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    ingest_id: str,
    env: IngestEnvelope,
    shop_uuid: str | None,
) -> None:
    p = env.payload
    campaign = str(p.get("campaign_name") or p.get("campaign") or "").strip()
    if not campaign or not env.biz_date or not env.shop_id:
        raise ValueError("tiktok_ads 需要 shop_id, biz_date, payload.campaign_name")

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO tk.fact_ads_campaign_daily (
                id, shop_id, shop_external_id, shop_name, biz_date, campaign_name,
                spend, orders, roi, revenue, currency, row_status, source_url,
                plan_status, delivery_status, daily_budget, target_roi, net_cost, avg_order_cost,
                collected_at, ingest_id, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :shop_id, :shop_external_id, :shop_name, :biz_date, :campaign_name,
                :spend, :orders, :roi, :revenue, :currency, :row_status, :source_url,
                :plan_status, :delivery_status, :daily_budget, :target_roi, :net_cost, :avg_order_cost,
                :collected_at, :ingest_id, now(), now()
            )
            ON CONFLICT (shop_external_id, campaign_name, biz_date) DO UPDATE SET
                spend = EXCLUDED.spend,
                orders = EXCLUDED.orders,
                roi = EXCLUDED.roi,

content.text:
**结论先说：TK 的 PG 底座已经差不多了，可以开始真实对接；但还不能说“现在打开任务台就能直接看真实 TK 业务”。**

更准确是：

> **数据层 + 写入链路基本就绪，任务台读链路和 TK 专属页面还没接上。**

---

## 现在已经有什么

| 层 | 状态 | 说明 |
|----|------|------|
| PG `tk` schema | ✅ | 广告/订单/商品/店KPI/健康/财务 + 异常任务表都在 |
| 异常类型字典 | ✅ | `tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type` |
| Ingest 写入 | ✅ | 后端能把 ads/orders/products/shop/health/finance/**anomaly_task** 写入 PG |
| 中心任务引擎 | ✅ | `public.task` 列表/新建/进度/闭环 API 可用 |
| 任务台通用能力 | ✅ | 登录、异常任务中心、店铺主数据、飞书同步入口 |
| 飞书同步 Job | ✅/部分 | TK 同步代码在，偏 PG→飞书出口 |

本机库刚才实查：

- TK 店：3 家（Deal to deal / Gardena / Pop）
- 广告：26 行
- 订单：1 行
- 商品/KPI/健康/财务：基本还是空
- `tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task`：1 条 smoke
- `public.task` 里 TikTok：25 条（多半是演示种子，不是从真实异常规则长出来的）

生产库（文档 7/31 快照）更像“真实采集库”：订单/广告有数，但当时 **task 还是 0**。

---

## 还差什么（所以还不能算“已真实对接”）

1. **没有 TK 读接口**  
   后端几乎只有 Ingest 写入 `tk.*`，没有给任务台用的：
   - TK 总览
   - 广告列表/汇总
   - `tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task` 列表与处置  
   现有任务 API 只读 `public.task`，不读 TK 异常事实表。

2. **任务台 TK 页面大多还是壳**  
   `tk-overview` / `tk-ads` / `tk-report` 基本是导航 +「规划中」占位。  
   真正接了 API 的，主要是：
   - 统一「异常任务中心」→ `/api/v1/tasks`
   - 店铺主数据 → `/api/v1/shops`

3. **两套任务还没完全打通**  
   - `tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task`：TK 业务异常事实（对齐飞书）  
   - `public.task`：中心任务引擎  
   表设计里有 `center_task_id`，但任务台还没把它当成主链路来用。

4. **本机数据不够“真”**  
   本机偏联调/种子；要看真数，要么连生产只读，要么把采集结果重新 ingest 进本机。

---

## 判断

| 问题 | 答案 |
|------|------|
| TK 的 PG 是不是搭得差不多了？ | **是** |
| 能不能开始对接任务台？ | **能，而且现在就该接** |
| 是不是已经可以当正式 TK 工作台用？ | **还不行** |
| 最小可闭环从哪切？ | **TK 异常任务：PG → API → 任务台列表/处置** |

---

## 建议的真实对接顺序（最小闭环）

1. **先接「TK 异常任务」**  
   - API 读/更新 `tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task`  
   - 任务台 `tk-tasks` 不再只是跳转壳  
   - 处置时同步 `public.task`（或先只做 TK 表）

2. **再接「TK 广告投流」**  
   - 读 `tk.fact_ads_campaign_daily`  
   - 任务台 `tk-ads` 显示花费/订单/ROI

3. **然后接「平台总览」**  
   - 店、广告汇总、开放异常数

4. **数据源**  
   - 演示：本机 + 现有/补录 ingest  
   - 真用：生产 API/只读库，或采集 dual 写入中心

---

**一句话：库已经够你开干了，不是还要先把 TK 表继续搭很久；真正缺的是「任务台读 API + TK 页面接线 + 异常任务闭环」。**

如果你要，我下一步可以直接开工，优先做：

**TK 异常任务真实对接（API + 任务台页面）**

"""任务引擎：去重键 + 进行中唯一 + 闭环后重建。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import get_settings
from app.domain import kb as kb_mod


def build_dedupe_key(platform: str, biz_id: str, anomaly_type: str) -> str:
    return f"{platform}:{biz_id}:{anomaly_type}"


async def enqueue_feishu_sync(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> None:
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload)
            VALUES (:id, 'feishu.sync', 'task', :task_id, CAST(:payload AS jsonb))
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "payload": f'{{"table_key":"tasks","local_id":"{task_id}"}}',
        },
    )


async def upsert_task_from_anomaly(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    platform: str,
    shop_id: str | None,
    anomaly_type: str,
    biz_id: str,
    title: str,
    detail: str | None = None,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    owner_user_id: str | None = None,
    severity: str = "warn",
    biz_id_type: str = "unknown",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """存在未闭环同键任务则更新进度；否则新建。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    dedupe = build_dedupe_key(platform, biz_id, anomaly_type)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    event_id = str(uuid4())

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO anomaly_event (
                id, platform, shop_id, anomaly_type, biz_id, biz_id_type,
                dedupe_key, severity, title, detail, payload, detected_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :platform, :shop_id, :anomaly_type, :biz_id, :biz_id_type,
                :dedupe_key, :severity, :title, :detail, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), :detected_at
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": event_id,
            "platform": platform,
            "shop_id": shop_id,
            "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
            "biz_id": biz_id,
            "biz_id_type": biz_id_type,
            "dedupe_key": dedupe,
            "severity": severity,
            "title": title,
            "detail": detail,
            "payload": __import__("json").dumps(payload or {}, ensure_ascii=False),
            "detected_at": now,
        },
    )

    existing = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text, status, progress_note
                FROM task
                WHERE dedupe_key = :dedupe AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                LIMIT 1
                """
            ),
            {"dedupe": dedupe},
        )
    ).mappings().first()

    if existing:
        note = detail or title
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE task
                SET progress_note = :note,
                    source_event_id = :event_id,
                    updated_at = :now,
                    status = CASE WHEN status = 'open' THEN 'in_progress' ELSE status END
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"note": note, "event_id": event_id, "now": now, "id": existing["id"]},
        )
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO task_progress (id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status)
                VALUES (:id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, 'in_progress')
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": str(uuid4()),
                "task_id": existing["id"],
                "note": note,
                "from_status": existing["status"],
            },
        )
        await db.execute(
            text("UPDATE anomaly_event SET task_id = :task_id WHERE id = :id"),
            {"task_id": existing["id"], "id": event_id},
        )
        await enqueue_feishu_sync(db, existing["id"])
        await db.commit()
        return await get_task(db, existing["id"])

    task_id = str(uuid4())
    due_at = now + timedelta(days=settings.default_task_due_days)
    try:
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO task (
                    id, dedupe_key, status, platform, shop_id, anomaly_type, biz_id,
                    title, owner_user_id, due_at, progress_note, source_event_id,
                    created_at, updated_at
                ) VALUES (
                    :id, :dedupe_key, 'open', :platform, :shop_id, :anomaly_type, :biz_id,
                    :title, :owner_user_id, :due_at, :progress_note, :source_event_id,
                    :now, :now
                )
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": task_id,
                "dedupe_key": dedupe,
                "platform": platform,
                "shop_id": shop_id,
                "anomaly_type": anomaly_type,
                "biz_id": biz_id,
                "title": title,
                "owner_user_id": owner_user_id,
                "due_at": due_at,
                "progress_note": detail,
                "source_event_id": event_id,
                "now": now,
            },
        )

    if not row:
        raise ValueError("task not found")

async def update_progress(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    note: str,
    status: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
    action_code: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    current = await get_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] in ("resolved", "cancelled"):
        raise ValueError("已闭环/取消的任务不能更新进度")
    new_status = status or "in_progress"
    if new_status not in ("open", "in_progress"):
        raise ValueError("进度接口仅允许 open/in_progress")
    await kb_mod.validate_action_code(db, action_code)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE task
            SET progress_note = :note,
                status = :status,
                updated_at = :now,
                last_action_code = COALESCE(:action_code, last_action_code)
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "note": note,
            "status": new_status,
            "now": now,
            "id": task_id,
            "action_code": action_code,
        },
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO task_progress (
                id, task_id, note, from_status, to_status, operator_user_id, action_code
            )
            VALUES (
                :id, :task_id, :note, :from_status, :to_status, :operator, :action_code
            )

            "action_code": action_code,

    await db.commit()
    return await get_task(db, task_id)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain import task_engine

OPEN_STATUSES = ("open", "in_progress")
CLOSED_STATUSES = ("resolved", "cancelled", "ignored")
ALL_STATUSES = OPEN_STATUSES + CLOSED_STATUSES
PRIORITIES = ("P0", "P1", "P2")
OBJECT_TYPES = ("product", "campaign", "shop", "order", "other")

_SELECT_COLS = """
    id::text,
    task_key,

    collected_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    resolved_at
"""


def _row_to_dict(row: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    d = dict(row)
    for k, v in list(d.items()):
        if isinstance(v, datetime):
            d[k] = v.isoformat()
        elif isinstance(v, date):
            d[k] = v.isoformat()
    return d


async def list_anomaly_types(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,

) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    clauses = ["1=1"]

    rows = (

                f"""

                       description, enabled, sort_order

                """

async def get_anomaly_task(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

async def list_anomaly_tasks(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    status: str | None = None,
    priority: str | None = None,
    anomaly_code: str | None = None,
    shop_external_id: str | None = None,
    object_type: str | None = None,
    q: str | None = None,
    open_only: bool = False,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    clauses = ["1=1"]
    params: dict[str, Any] = {
        "limit": page_size,
        "offset": (page - 1) * page_size,
    }
    if status:
        clauses.append("status = :status")
        params["status"] = status
    elif open_only:
        clauses.append("status IN ('open', 'in_progress')")
    if priority:
        clauses.append("priority = :priority")
        params["priority"] = priority
    if anomaly_code:
        clauses.append("anomaly_code = :anomaly_code")
        params["anomaly_code"] = anomaly_code
    if shop_external_id:
        clauses.append("shop_external_id = :shop_external_id")
        params["shop_external_id"] = shop_external_id
    if object_type:
        clauses.append("object_type = :object_type")
        params["object_type"] = object_type
    if q:
        clauses.append(
            """
            (
                coalesce(summary, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(product_name, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(product_name_cn, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(product_id, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(seller_sku, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(object_ref, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(shop_name, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(task_key, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(anomaly_type, '') ILIKE :q
            )
            """
        )
        params["q"] = f"%{q.strip()}%"

    where = " AND ".join(clauses)
    total = (
        await db.execute(
            text(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task WHERE {where}"),
            params,
        )
    ).scalar_one()

    # 汇总：未过滤分页的开放单数量（同一 where 下按 status）
    status_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS cnt
                FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                WHERE {where}
                GROUP BY status
                """
            ),
            params,
        )
    ).mappings().all()
    by_status = {r["status"]: r["cnt"] for r in status_rows}

    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT {_SELECT_COLS}
                FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                WHERE {where}
                ORDER BY
                    CASE priority WHEN 'P0' THEN 0 WHEN 'P1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
                    CASE status
                        WHEN 'open' THEN 0
                        WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 1
                        ELSE 2
                    END,
                    biz_date DESC,
                    updated_at DESC
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
                """
            ),
            params,
        )
    ).mappings().all()

    return {
        "total": total,
        "items": [_row_to_dict(r) for r in rows],
        "summary": {
            "open": by_status.get("open", 0),
            "in_progress": by_status.get("in_progress", 0),
            "resolved": by_status.get("resolved", 0),
            "cancelled": by_status.get("cancelled", 0),
            "ignored": by_status.get("ignored", 0),
        },
    }


async def _lookup_type(db: AsyncSession, anomaly_code: str | None, anomaly_type: str | None) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:
    """返回 (code, name_cn, object_type, priority_default)。"""
    code = (anomaly_code or "").strip().lower() or None
    name = (anomaly_type or "").strip() or None

    row = None
    if code:

    if not row and name:
        row = (

                    FROM tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type
                    WHERE name_cn = :name OR code = :name
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"name": name},
            )
        ).mappings().first()

    if row:
        return (
            row["code"],
            row["name_cn"],
            row["object_type"],
            row["priority_default"],
        )
    return (
        code or "other",
        name or code or "其它",

        "P1",
    )

    db: AsyncSession,

    *,
    status: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,

) -> dict[str, Any]:

    if current["status"] in CLOSED_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError("已闭环/取消/忽略的任务不能更新进度")

    new_status = status or "in_progress"
    if new_status not in OPEN_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError("进度接口仅允许 open/in_progress")

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
            SET progress_note = :note,
                status = :status,
                owner_name = COALESCE(:owner_name, owner_name),
                owner_user_id = COALESCE(CAST(:owner_user_id AS uuid), owner_user_id),
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": task_id,
            "note": note,
            "status": new_status,
            "owner_name": owner_name,
            "owner_user_id": operator_user_id,
        },
    )

    # 镜像中心任务
    center_id = current.get("center_task_id")
    if center_id:
        try:

                center_id,

                status=new_status,
                operator_user_id=operator_user_id,
            )
        except ValueError:
            # 中心任务已关也不挡 TK 表更新
            await db.commit()
    else:
        await db.commit()

    return await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)


async def resolve_task(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    *,
    note: str | None = None,
    status: str = "resolved",
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
    owner_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if status not in CLOSED_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError("闭环接口仅允许 resolved/cancelled/ignored")

    current = await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] in CLOSED_STATUSES:
        return current

    final_note = note or current.get("progress_note") or (
        "已忽略" if status == "ignored" else "已取消" if status == "cancelled" else "已闭环"
    )
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
            SET status = :status,
                progress_note = :note,
                owner_name = COALESCE(:owner_name, owner_name),
                owner_user_id = COALESCE(CAST(:owner_user_id AS uuid), owner_user_id),
                resolved_at = :now,
                updated_at = :now
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": task_id,
            "status": status,
            "note": final_note,
            "owner_name": owner_name,
            "owner_user_id": operator_user_id,
            "now": now,
        },
    )

    center_id = current.get("center_task_id")
    if center_id and status == "resolved":
        try:
            await task_engine.resolve_task(
                db,
                center_id,
                note=final_note,
                operator_user_id=operator_user_id,
            )
        except ValueError:
            await db.commit()
    elif center_id and status in ("cancelled", "ignored"):
        # 中心任务没有 ignored；映射为 cancelled
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE task
                SET status = 'cancelled',
                    progress_note = :note,
                    updated_at = :now,
                    resolved_at = :now
                WHERE id = :id AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                """
            ),
            {"id": center_id, "note": final_note, "now": now},
        )
        await db.commit()
    else:
        await db.commit()

    return await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)

    updated_at,
    resolved_at
"""


def _row_to_dict(row: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    d = dict(row)
    for k, v in list(d.items()):
        if isinstance(v, datetime):
            d[k] = v.isoformat()
        elif isinstance(v, date):
            d[k] = v.isoformat()
    return d


async def list_anomaly_types(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    enabled_only: bool = True,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    clauses = ["1=1"]
    if enabled_only:
        clauses.append("enabled = TRUE")
    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT code, name_cn, object_type, severity_default, priority_default,
                       description, enabled, sort_order
                FROM tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type
                WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}
                ORDER BY sort_order, code
                """
            )
        )
    ).mappings().all()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


async def get_anomaly_task(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT {_SELECT_COLS}
                FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"id": task_id},
        )
    ).mappings().first()
    if not row:
        raise ValueError("tk anomaly task not found")
    return _row_to_dict(row)


async def list_anomaly_tasks(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    status: str | None = None,
    priority: str | None = None,
    anomaly_code: str | None = None,
    shop_external_id: str | None = None,
    object_type: str | None = None,
    q: str | None = None,
    open_only: bool = False,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    clauses = ["1=1"]
    params: dict[str, Any] = {
        "limit": page_size,
        "offset": (page - 1) * page_size,
    }
    if status:
        clauses.append("status = :status")
        params["status"] = status
    elif open_only:
        clauses.append("status IN ('open', 'in_progress')")
    if priority:
        clauses.append("priority = :priority")
        params["priority"] = priority
    if anomaly_code:
        clauses.append("anomaly_code = :anomaly_code")
        params["anomaly_code"] = anomaly_code
    if shop_external_id:
        clauses.append("shop_external_id = :shop_external_id")
        params["shop_external_id"] = shop_external_id
    if object_type:
        clauses.append("object_type = :object_type")
        params["object_type"] = object_type
    if q:
        clauses.append(
            """
            (
                coalesce(summary, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(product_name, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(product_name_cn, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(product_id, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(seller_sku, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(object_ref, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(shop_name, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(task_key, '') ILIKE :q
                OR coalesce(anomaly_type, '') ILIKE :q
            )
            """
        )
        params["q"] = f"%{q.strip()}%"

    where = " AND ".join(clauses)
    total = (
        await db.execute(
            text(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task WHERE {where}"),
            params,
        )
    ).scalar_one()

    # 汇总：未过滤分页的开放单数量（同一 where 下按 status）
    status_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS cnt
                FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                WHERE {where}
                GROUP BY status
                """
            ),
            params,
        )
    ).mappings().all()
    by_status = {r["status"]: r["cnt"] for r in status_rows}

    rows = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                f"""
                SELECT {_SELECT_COLS}
                FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                WHERE {where}
                ORDER BY
                    CASE priority WHEN 'P0' THEN 0 WHEN 'P1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
                    CASE status
                        WHEN 'open' THEN 0
                        WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 1
                        ELSE 2
                    END,
                    biz_date DESC,
                    updated_at DESC
                LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
                """
            ),
            params,
        )
    ).mappings().all()

    return {
        "total": total,
        "items": [_row_to_dict(r) for r in rows],
        "summary": {
            "open": by_status.get("open", 0),
            "in_progress": by_status.get("in_progress", 0),
            "resolved": by_status.get("resolved", 0),
            "cancelled": by_status.get("cancelled", 0),
            "ignored": by_status.get("ignored", 0),
        },
    }


async def _lookup_type(db: AsyncSession, anomaly_code: str | None, anomaly_type: str | None) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:
    """返回 (code, name_cn, object_type, priority_default)。"""
    code = (anomaly_code or "").strip().lower() or None
    name = (anomaly_type or "").strip() or None

    row = None
    if code:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT code, name_cn, object_type, priority_default
                    FROM tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type
                    WHERE code = :code
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"code": code},
            )
        ).mappings().first()
    if not row and name:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT code, name_cn, object_type, priority_default
                    FROM tk.dim_tk_anomaly_type
                    WHERE name_cn = :name OR code = :name
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"name": name},
            )
        ).mappings().first()

    if row:
        return (
            row["code"],
            row["name_cn"],
            row["object_type"],
            row["priority_default"],
        )
    return (
        code or "other",
        name or code or "其它",
        "other",
        "P1",
    )


def _make_task_key(*, biz_date: date, shop: str, obj: str, code: str) -> str:
    day = biz_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    safe_obj = (obj or "unknown").replace(" ", "")[:48]
    safe_shop = (shop or "nosshop")[-8:]
    return f"T{day}-{safe_shop}-{safe_obj}-{code}"[:120]


async def create_anomaly_task(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    anomaly_code: str | None = None,
    anomaly_type: str | None = None,
    summary: str | None = None,
    shop_id: str | None = None,
    shop_external_id: str | None = None,
    shop_name: str | None = None,
    product_id: str | None = None,
    seller_sku: str | None = None,
    product_name: str | None = None,
    product_name_cn: str | None = None,
    object_ref: str | None = None,
    object_type: str | None = None,
    priority: str | None = None,
    owner_name: str | None = None,
    owner_user_id: str | None = None,
    due_at: datetime | None = None,
    progress_note: str | None = None,
    metric_snapshot: str | None = None,
    biz_date: date | None = None,
    task_key: str | None = None,
    dedupe_key: str | None = None,
    source_url: str | None = None,
    project_center_task: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code, name_cn, type_obj, pri_default = await _lookup_type(db, anomaly_code, anomaly_type)
    obj_type = (object_type or type_obj or "other").strip().lower()
    if obj_type not in OBJECT_TYPES:
        obj_type = "other"

    pri = (priority or pri_default or "P1").strip().upper()
    if pri not in PRIORITIES:
        pri = "P1"

    bd = biz_date or date.today()
    shop_ext = (shop_external_id or "").strip() or None
    shop_nm = (shop_name or "").strip() or None

    if shop_id and (not shop_ext or not shop_nm):
        shop_row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text, external_shop_id, name
                    FROM shop WHERE id = :id LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"id": shop_id},
            )
        ).mappings().first()
        if shop_row:
            shop_id = shop_row["id"]
            shop_ext = shop_ext or shop_row["external_shop_id"]
            shop_nm = shop_nm or shop_row["name"]

    if not shop_id and shop_ext:
        shop_row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text, external_shop_id, name
                    FROM shop
                    WHERE external_shop_id = :eid AND platform = 'tiktok'
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"eid": shop_ext},
            )
        ).mappings().first()
        if shop_row:
            shop_id = shop_row["id"]
            shop_nm = shop_nm or shop_row["name"]

    obj_ref = (
        (object_ref or "").strip()
        or (product_id or "").strip()
        or (seller_sku or "").strip()
        or (shop_ext or "").strip()
        or None
    )
    if not obj_ref:
        raise ValueError("需要 object_ref / product_id / seller_sku / shop_external_id 之一")

    tk = (task_key or "").strip() or _make_task_key(
        biz_date=bd,
        shop=str(shop_ext or ""),
        obj=str(obj_ref),
        code=code,
    )
    dk = (dedupe_key or "").strip() or f"tiktok:{obj_ref}:{code}"
    title = (summary or "").strip() or name_cn

    # 未闭环去重
    existing = (
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                SELECT id::text
                FROM tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                WHERE dedupe_key = :dk AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                LIMIT 1
                """
            ),
            {"dk": dk},
        )
    ).first()
    if existing:
        # 更新摘要/进度后返回
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
                SET summary = :summary,
                    progress_note = COALESCE(:note, progress_note),
                    metric_snapshot = COALESCE(:metric, metric_snapshot),
                    priority = :priority,
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": existing[0],
                "summary": title,
                "note": progress_note,
                "metric": metric_snapshot,
                "priority": pri,
            },
        )
        await db.commit()
        return await get_anomaly_task(db, existing[0])

    center_task_id = None
    if project_center_task:
        center = await task_engine.upsert_task_from_anomaly(
            db,
            platform="tiktok",
            shop_id=shop_id,
            anomaly_type=code,
            biz_id=str(obj_ref),
            title=title,
            detail=progress_note or metric_snapshot,
            payload={
                "source": "tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task",
                "task_key": tk,
                "anomaly_code": code,
                "anomaly_type": name_cn,
            },
            owner_user_id=owner_user_id,
            severity="high" if pri == "P0" else "warn",
            biz_id_type=obj_type,
        )
        center_task_id = center["id"]

    new_id = str(uuid4())
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task (
                id, task_key, biz_date, shop_id, shop_external_id, shop_name,
                product_id, seller_sku, product_name, product_name_cn,
                object_ref, object_type, anomaly_type, anomaly_code,
                priority, status, owner_name, owner_user_id, due_at, progress_note,
                summary, metric_snapshot, center_task_id, dedupe_key,
                source_url, row_status, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :task_key, :biz_date, CAST(:shop_id AS uuid), :shop_external_id, :shop_name,
                :product_id, :seller_sku, :product_name, :product_name_cn,
                :object_ref, :object_type, :anomaly_type, :anomaly_code,
                :priority, 'open', :owner_name, CAST(:owner_user_id AS uuid), :due_at, :progress_note,
                :summary, :metric_snapshot, CAST(:center_task_id AS uuid), :dedupe_key,
                :source_url, 'success', now(), now()
            )
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": new_id,
            "task_key": tk,
            "biz_date": bd,
            "shop_id": shop_id,
            "shop_external_id": shop_ext,
            "shop_name": shop_nm,
            "product_id": (product_id or "").strip() or None,
            "seller_sku": (seller_sku or "").strip() or None,
            "product_name": (product_name or "").strip() or None,
            "product_name_cn": (product_name_cn or "").strip() or None,
            "object_ref": obj_ref,
            "object_type": obj_type,
            "anomaly_type": name_cn,
            "anomaly_code": code,
            "priority": pri,
            "owner_name": (owner_name or "").strip() or None,
            "owner_user_id": owner_user_id,
            "due_at": due_at,
            "progress_note": progress_note,
            "summary": title,
            "metric_snapshot": metric_snapshot,
            "center_task_id": center_task_id,
            "dedupe_key": dk,
            "source_url": source_url,
        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    return await get_anomaly_task(db, new_id)


async def update_progress(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    note: str,
    *,
    status: str | None = None,
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
    owner_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    current = await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] in CLOSED_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError("已闭环/取消/忽略的任务不能更新进度")

    new_status = status or "in_progress"
    if new_status not in OPEN_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError("进度接口仅允许 open/in_progress")

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
            SET progress_note = :note,
                status = :status,
                owner_name = COALESCE(:owner_name, owner_name),
                owner_user_id = COALESCE(CAST(:owner_user_id AS uuid), owner_user_id),
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": task_id,
            "note": note,
            "status": new_status,
            "owner_name": owner_name,
            "owner_user_id": operator_user_id,
        },
    )

    # 镜像中心任务
    center_id = current.get("center_task_id")
    if center_id:
        try:
            await task_engine.update_progress(
                db,
                center_id,
                note,
                status=new_status,
                operator_user_id=operator_user_id,
            )
        except ValueError:
            # 中心任务已关也不挡 TK 表更新
            await db.commit()
    else:
        await db.commit()

    return await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)


async def resolve_task(
    db: AsyncSession,
    task_id: str,
    *,
    note: str | None = None,
    status: str = "resolved",
    operator_user_id: str | None = None,
    owner_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if status not in CLOSED_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError("闭环接口仅允许 resolved/cancelled/ignored")

    current = await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)
    if current["status"] in CLOSED_STATUSES:
        return current

    final_note = note or current.get("progress_note") or (
        "已忽略" if status == "ignored" else "已取消" if status == "cancelled" else "已闭环"
    )
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            UPDATE tk.fact_tk_anomaly_task
            SET status = :status,
                progress_note = :note,
                owner_name = COALESCE(:owner_name, owner_name),
                owner_user_id = COALESCE(CAST(:owner_user_id AS uuid), owner_user_id),
                resolved_at = :now,
                updated_at = :now
            WHERE id = :id
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": task_id,
            "status": status,
            "note": final_note,
            "owner_name": owner_name,
            "owner_user_id": operator_user_id,
            "now": now,
        },
    )

    center_id = current.get("center_task_id")
    if center_id and status == "resolved":
        try:
            await task_engine.resolve_task(
                db,
                center_id,
                note=final_note,
                operator_user_id=operator_user_id,
            )
        except ValueError:
            await db.commit()
    elif center_id and status in ("cancelled", "ignored"):
        # 中心任务没有 ignored；映射为 cancelled
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE task
                SET status = 'cancelled',
                    progress_note = :note,
                    updated_at = :now,
                    resolved_at = :now
                WHERE id = :id AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
                """
            ),
            {"id": center_id, "note": final_note, "now": now},
        )
        await db.commit()
    else:
        await db.commit()

    return await get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)

"""TK 异常任务 API：列表 / 详情 / 新建 / 进度 / 闭环。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain import tk_anomaly
from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks", tags=["tk-anomaly-tasks"])


class TkAnomalyCreate(BaseModel):
    anomaly_code: str | None = None
    anomaly_type: str | None = None
    summary: str | None = None
    shop_id: str | None = None
    shop_external_id: str | None = None

    biz_date: date | None = None
    task_key: str | None = None
    dedupe_key: str | None = None
    source_url: str | None = None
    project_center_task: bool = True


class ProgressBody(BaseModel):
    note: str = Field(min_length=1)
    status: Literal["open", "in_progress"] | None = "in_progress"
    owner_name: str | None = None


class ResolveBody(BaseModel):
    note: str | None = None
    status: Literal["resolved", "cancelled", "ignored"] = "resolved"
    owner_name: str | None = None


@router.get("/types")
async def list_types(
    enabled_only: bool = True,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    items = await tk_anomaly.list_anomaly_types(db, enabled_only=enabled_only)

    status: str | None = None,

    object_type: str | None = None,

    try:

        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    body: TkAnomalyCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not body.anomaly_code and not body.anomaly_type:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="需要 anomaly_code 或 anomaly_type")
    try:
        return await tk_anomaly.create_anomaly_task(

        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{task_id}/progress")
async def progress(
    task_id: str,
    body: ProgressBody,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),

        msg = str(exc)
        code = 404 if "not found" in msg else 400
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=msg) from exc

    task_id: str,

) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:

            operator_user_id=user.get("id"),
            owner_name=body.owner_name or user.get("display_name") or user.get("username"),
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        msg = str(exc)
        code = 404 if "not found" in msg else 400
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=msg) from exc

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.domain import tk_anomaly
from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks", tags=["tk-anomaly-tasks"])


class TkAnomalyCreate(BaseModel):
    anomaly_code: str | None = None
    anomaly_type: str | None = None
    summary: str | None = None
    shop_id: str | None = None
    shop_external_id: str | None = None
    shop_name: str | None = None
    product_id: str | None = None
    seller_sku: str | None = None
    product_name: str | None = None
    product_name_cn: str | None = None
    object_ref: str | None = None
    object_type: str | None = None
    priority: str | None = None
    owner_name: str | None = None
    due_at: datetime | None = None
    progress_note: str | None = None
    metric_snapshot: str | None = None
    biz_date: date | None = None
    task_key: str | None = None
    dedupe_key: str | None = None
    source_url: str | None = None
    project_center_task: bool = True


class ProgressBody(BaseModel):
    note: str = Field(min_length=1)
    status: Literal["open", "in_progress"] | None = "in_progress"
    owner_name: str | None = None


class ResolveBody(BaseModel):
    note: str | None = None
    status: Literal["resolved", "cancelled", "ignored"] = "resolved"
    owner_name: str | None = None


@router.get("/types")
async def list_types(
    enabled_only: bool = True,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    items = await tk_anomaly.list_anomaly_types(db, enabled_only=enabled_only)
    return {"items": items}


@router.get("")
async def list_tasks(
    status: str | None = None,
    priority: str | None = None,
    anomaly_code: str | None = None,
    shop_external_id: str | None = None,
    object_type: str | None = None,
    q: str | None = None,
    open_only: bool = False,
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return await tk_anomaly.list_anomaly_tasks(
        db,
        status=status,
        priority=priority,
        anomaly_code=anomaly_code,
        shop_external_id=shop_external_id,
        object_type=object_type,
        q=q,
        open_only=open_only,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
    )


@router.get("/{task_id}")
async def get_task(
    task_id: str,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return await tk_anomaly.get_anomaly_task(db, task_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_task(
    body: TkAnomalyCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not body.anomaly_code and not body.anomaly_type:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="需要 anomaly_code 或 anomaly_type")
    try:
        return await tk_anomaly.create_anomaly_task(
            db,
            anomaly_code=body.anomaly_code,
            anomaly_type=body.anomaly_type,
            summary=body.summary,
            shop_id=body.shop_id,
            shop_external_id=body.shop_external_id,
            shop_name=body.shop_name,
            product_id=body.product_id,
            seller_sku=body.seller_sku,
            product_name=body.product_name,
            product_name_cn=body.product_name_cn,
            object_ref=body.object_ref,
            object_type=body.object_type,
            priority=body.priority,
            owner_name=body.owner_name or user.get("display_name") or user.get("username"),
            owner_user_id=user.get("id"),
            due_at=body.due_at,
            progress_note=body.progress_note,
            metric_snapshot=body.metric_snapshot,
            biz_date=body.biz_date,
            task_key=body.task_key,
            dedupe_key=body.dedupe_key,
            source_url=body.source_url,
            project_center_task=body.project_center_task,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from exc


@router.post("/{task_id}/progress")
async def progress(
    task_id: str,
    body: ProgressBody,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return await tk_anomaly.update_progress(
            db,
            task_id,
            body.note,
            status=body.status,
            operator_user_id=user.get("id"),
            owner_name=body.owner_name or user.get("display_name") or user.get("username"),
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        msg = str(exc)
        code = 404 if "not found" in msg else 400
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=msg) from exc


@router.post("/{task_id}/resolve")
async def resolve(
    task_id: str,
    body: ResolveBody,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return await tk_anomaly.resolve_task(
            db,
            task_id,
            note=body.note,
            status=body.status,
            operator_user_id=user.get("id"),
            owner_name=body.owner_name or user.get("display_name") or user.get("username"),
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        msg = str(exc)
        code = 404 if "not found" in msg else 400
        raise HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=msg) from exc

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.api import auth, export_feishu, health, ingest, kb, shops, tasks, tk_anomaly_tasks
from app.config import get_settings


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    settings = get_settings()
    app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_name, version="0.1.0")
    app.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=["*"],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )
    app.include_router(health.router)
    app.include_router(auth.router)
    app.include_router(shops.router)
    app.include_router(ingest.router)
    app.include_router(tasks.router)
    app.include_router(tk_anomaly_tasks.router)
    app.include_router(kb.router)
    app.include_router(export_feishu.router_export)
    app.include_router(export_feishu.router_collectors)
    return app


app = create_app()

"""TK 异常任务 API 集成测试。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

import pytest


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_tk_anomaly_types(client, auth_headers):
    r = await client.get("/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks/types", headers=auth_headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    items = r.json()["items"]
    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert any(i["code"] == "product_stock_low" for i in items)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_tk_anomaly_crud_flow(client, auth_headers):
    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    create_body = {
        "anomaly_code": "ads_roi_low",
        "summary": f"测试低ROI-{suffix}",
        "shop_external_id": "27501502216807",
        "object_ref": f"camp-{suffix}",
        "object_type": "campaign",
        "product_name": f"Test Campaign {suffix}",
        "priority": "P1",
        "metric_snapshot": "ROI=1.1 spend=20",
        "progress_note": "联调创建",
        "project_center_task": True,
    }
    r = await client.post("/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks", headers=auth_headers, json=create_body)
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    task = r.json()
    assert task["anomaly_code"] == "ads_roi_low"
    assert task["anomaly_type"] == "广告ROI过低"
    assert task["status"] == "open"
    assert task["center_task_id"]
    task_id = task["id"]

    # 列表能查到
    r = await client.get(
        "/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks",
        headers=auth_headers,
        params={"q": suffix, "open_only": True},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    data = r.json()
    assert data["total"] >= 1
    assert any(i["id"] == task_id for i in data["items"])
    assert "summary" in data

    # 详情
    r = await client.get(f"/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks/{task_id}", headers=auth_headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["task_key"] == task["task_key"]

    # 进度
    r = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks/{task_id}/progress",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"note": "已暂停投放观察", "status": "in_progress"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    assert r.json()["status"] == "in_progress"
    assert "已暂停" in (r.json().get("progress_note") or "")

    # 闭环
    r = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks/{task_id}/resolve",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"note": "ROI 回升，关闭", "status": "resolved"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    assert r.json()["status"] == "resolved"
    assert r.json()["resolved_at"]

    # 再更新进度应失败
    r = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tk/anomaly-tasks/{task_id}/progress",
        headers=auth_headers,
        json={"note": "不应成功"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 400
